rachel_fin: Quick flag 14: we have ~45 AWS Marketplace invoice lines missing `subscription_id` which prevents matching to reseller contracts. Noticed in daily export.

sam.billing: Example line?

rachel_fin: ```invoice_id,sku,customer_id,subscription_id,units,amount
aws-2026-06-03-511,ml-api,acct-9001,,300,150.00
```

ingestbot: Pipeline error: "required field missing: subscription_id" at 2026-06-03T07:12Z. Those rows were routed to DLQ to avoid misbilling.

mike_sre: Any recent exporter changes? We deployed exporter v3.0.1 yesterday.

sophia_partner: Partner ops confirmed they changed export segmentation and started sending a separate subscription mapping file. Looks like the join step failed. We'll ask them to resend mapping.

sam.billing: Short-term mitigation: accept rows with blank `subscription_id` and tag them `needs_sub_map:<date>` so finance can manually map. Create temporary guardrail to alert if >20 unmapped rows.

mike_sre: I'll open a hotfix branch to fallback to the subscription mapping cache on ingest when `subscription_id` is empty. PR link when ready.

invoicebot: Attached export: s3://billing/exports/aws/2026-06-03/marketplace.csv (sha256: aa7b...) and queued job rc-20260603-submap-reprocess.

rachel_fin: After partner resends mapping and we reprocess, please surface which invoice_ids changed so we can issue adjustments if needed. Thanks.
